title: Price-match promise
excerpt: Found it cheaper elsewhere? Toy Barnhaus will price match — just ask at the counter.
body: Toy Barnhaus price matches, so you can buy from an independent with confidence. See in store for details — and remember you can ring ahead to reserve any toy.

title: Bespoke scents, made for you
excerpt: Small-batch, vegan Extrait de parfum — blended to order in Worthing's own fragrance lab.
body: Formula Fragrances crafts clean, preservative-free fragrance in small batches — including bespoke scents and refills. Call in to talk through what you're after.

title: Group escapes at Mindworks
excerpt: Birthdays, team days and family showdowns — book a room and beat the clock together.
body: Mindworks Escape Rooms hosts groups for birthdays, corporate days and get-togethers. Book your slot on their website and turn up ready to puzzle.

title: Summer at the Guildbourne
excerpt: Longer days, a makers market and plenty to discover — make the most of summer under our roof.
